 Free Medicare Information Session Scheduled Thursday at Pasadena Library 
 Community presentation will address enrollment deadlines, prescription costs, Medi-Cal changes and assistance with coverage expenses 
 Published on Nov 11, 2026 
 Pasadena residents seeking information about Medicare coverage, prescription drug costs and enrollment options will have an opportunity to attend a free educational presentation Thursday, Nov. 12, at Lamanda Park Branch Library.  
 The hourlong session, scheduled from 2 to 3 p.m., is being organized by Pasadena-based TRH Insurance, according to a press release issued Tuesday. The presentation is intended for older adults, family members and caregivers navigating Medicare decisions during the annual enrollment period.  
 Medicare’s annual open enrollment period runs from Oct. 15 through Dec. 7. During that time, eligible beneficiaries can review and make changes to Medicare Advantage and prescription drug coverage for the following year. Changes made during the period generally take effect Jan. 1.  
 The federal Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services recommends that beneficiaries review their existing coverage annually because insurance plans may change their costs, benefits, participating providers and covered medications. 
 According to the organizer, Thursday’s presentation will cover annual Medicare coverage reviews, changes involving Medi-Cal, preparations for people approaching age 65, prescription drug costs and programs that may help eligible individuals pay Medicare expenses.  
 The session also will address considerations for families helping relatives make healthcare coverage decisions.  
 Thermon “Rick” Holliday, founder and principal broker of TRH Insurance, said the event is intended to explain Medicare information before individuals make enrollment decisions.  
 “Medicare rules and costs shift from year to year, and families deserve to hear about those changes from a source they can trust, in words that make sense,” Holliday said in the company’s announcement.  
 The event is being presented through the agency’s Medicare Education for Consumers, Caregivers, and Advocates initiative, known as MECCA, which the company says provides educational presentations through community organizations.  
 Because the presenter is a private insurance agency, attendees should distinguish general Medicare information from recommendations involving particular insurance products. Independent information about coverage and enrollment is also available through Medicare.gov.  
 The organizer said admission is free, light refreshments will be provided and seating is limited. Advance reservations are encouraged. 
 NEED TO KNOW: The free Medicare education session is scheduled for Thursday, Nov. 12, from 2 to 3 p.m. in the community room at Lamanda Park Branch Library, 140 S. Altadena Drive, Pasadena. To RSVP, call 626-542-7080. The event is organized by TRH Insurance, a private insurance agency.
